items.contentSnippet:
I’m building FlareDB, a Rust-based streaming database with Apache Beam as programing interfere 
The latest release, v0.2.0, i launched FlareDbIO, which lets data processing pipelines write results into FlareDB, query them using SQL, and read the results back into another pipeline.
The goal is to make processed data persistent and without having to maintain a external serving database

items.title: Show HN: Epistemic Physics: Bayesian Special Relativity
items.contentSnippet:
hihi hn! i made a blog post describing my framework for how to connect epistemology, statistics, physics, and other fields together! the gist of it is you treat probability as relativistic velocity, and evidence as spacetime.
the post is completely and painstakingly handwritten, though i used ai for the interactive demos, some double checking, and some brainstorming.
let me know what you think! i welcome corrections, suggestions, and comments, though the commenting system on my blog is untested
